summary: Verified Iter 83-84 fixes end-to-end. minor.issue: Response can take >15s when SMTP send_email is invoked for L1/L2 alert fan-out; used 60s client timeout in tests. Consider fire-and-forget/background task for email dispatch.

action_items: (Minor) Move new-version notification/email dispatch to a background task to avoid 15-60s response times when multiple L1 approvers + creator are alerted.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectUpdate model does not expose matrix_levels / matrix_approvers / current_approval_level / approval_history — this is by design (they are managed by submit/approve endpoints) and defends against tampering. Retain as-is; documented in test with a direct-DB fixture (_set_matrix) to install controlled scenarios.
approve_project authorization block correctly returns 403 with 'Waiting on: <emails>' and 409 for idempotent re-approve at the same level. Good.

create_new_version Option B: caller level is looked up from parent's matrix_levels by emails, and matrix state is carried over on L1 auto-submit (matrix_levels + matrix_approvers) — good. Version-alert branch also emails creator via existing.created_by_email — good.
seed_data_creation: Registered two throwaway approver users (test_l1_*/test_l2_*@example.com) per module; each test creates its own draft project and deletes it in teardown (or leaks harmlessly with TEST_ prefix).
